title: 第3683章 入口这家伙是傻子吧第3682章 身外之物感悟力妖孽
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
见识了叶凌强悍的感悟力，以及对法则力量的运用，幽梦是真的心服口服。
对于当初和叶凌签订契约一事，她如今只感到无比庆幸。
若是没能成功追随叶凌，自己未来想要成为巅峰主宰还不知道需要多久，更不用提宇宙至尊了。
那或许是自己穷尽一生，可能都无法触及到的层次。
时间在一点点流逝，叶凌一直都在感悟和提升对法则力量的运用，神宠们的实力也得到了极大的提升。
…………
一转眼，一个月就过去了。
白娅虽没有掌握速度法则，但在宇宙中穿行的速度却一点也不慢。
可即便如此，从人族疆域前往白虎圣地，也需要花费近一月时间才能做到。
从这便能看出，白虎圣地究竟有多远。
漆黑无垠的宇宙空间内，一道绚烂的白光快速穿过，瞬间飞向远方。
而在白光所前往的方向尽头，有一道若有若无的旋涡存在。
那道旋涡，仿佛能够将周围的一切全部吞噬。
周边没有任何星辰，甚至连陨石或是宇宙尘埃都不存在。
当看见前方那若隐若现的旋涡之时，白娅眼中闪过一丝怀念，速度也慢了下来。
“叶凌，前方就是白虎圣地的入口，穿过入口，便可以抵达白虎圣地。”
缓缓睁开双眼，叶凌闪过一抹微弱的精光，目光直接锁定远处那道旋涡。
那道旋涡中有十分明显的空间之力波动，很显然是利用空间法则构筑而成的特殊通道。
这处地界，寻常人几乎很难找到。
且这里作为白虎圣地的门户，绝不可能没有任何人看守才是。

哪怕猜也能猜到，此地界没那么简单。
突然，出现了数道陌生的气息，并以极快的速度向着叶凌他们所在的方向逼近
来了！
白娅自然也察觉到了这数道陌生气息逼近，眼神陡然一变。
坐在叶凌身旁的幽梦，嘴角微微扬起，笑呵呵地说道。
“主人，看来我们的到来引起了一些家伙的注意，对方现在找上门来，要怎么办？都杀了吗？”
只能说真不愧是虫族母皇，开口闭口就是喊打喊杀，完全没有一点手下留情的意思。
“不急，先看看情况。”
在叶凌声音落下后，先前出现的数道陌生气息，已经出现在他们前方不远处。
唰唰唰！
数道身影拦住了叶凌他们的去路。
一共四人，一个个看上去体型壮硕高大，但模样却颇为狰狞。
其中一个家伙只有一只眼睛，而有个家伙竟然有四只眼睛。
但这些家伙有个共同的特征，那就是他们头上有属于鬼族的角。
有这样奇特的特征，但又出自同一族的，只能是鬼族的家伙了。
为首的独眼鬼族立刻举起右手拦住叶凌他们，大声喝止。
“什么人？！来此地作甚！”
content_en:
After seeing Ye Ling's powerful perception and use of the power of laws, Youmeng was truly convinced.
She now only feels extremely lucky to have signed the contract with Ye Ling.
If he fails to follow Ye Ling, he doesn't know how long it will take him to become the pinnacle master in the future, let alone the supreme master of the universe.
That may be a level that I may not be able to reach in my entire life.
As time passes, Ye Ling has been comprehending and improving the use of the power of the law, and the strength of the divine pets has also been greatly improved.
…………
In the blink of an eye, a month passed.
Although Bai Ya has not mastered the law of speed, her speed through the universe is not slow at all.
But even so, it would take nearly a month to travel from the human territory to the White Tiger Holy Land.
From this we can see how far away the White Tiger Holy Land is.
In the dark and boundless space of the universe, a brilliant white light quickly passed through and flew into the distance instantly.
And at the end of the direction where the white light is heading, there is a vague vortex.
That vortex seemed to be able to swallow up everything around it.
There are no stars around, not even meteorites or cosmic dust.
When she saw the looming vortex in front of her, a trace of nostalgia flashed in Bai Ya's eyes, and her speed slowed down.
"Ye Ling, ahead is the entrance to the White Tiger Holy Land. Pass through the entrance and you can reach the White Tiger Holy Land."
Slowly opening his eyes, a faint light flashed across Ye Ling's eyes, and his eyes were directly fixed on the vortex in the distance.
There were very obvious fluctuations in the power of space in that vortex, and it was obviously a special passage constructed using the laws of space.
This place is almost difficult for ordinary people to find.
And as this is the gateway to the White Tiger Holy Land, there is absolutely no way it can be guarded by anyone.
Even if you have to guess, you can guess that this world is not that simple.
Suddenly, several unfamiliar auras appeared and approached Ye Ling and the others at extremely fast speeds.
Coming!
Bai Ya naturally noticed the approaching unfamiliar auras, and her eyes suddenly changed.
Youmeng, who was sitting next to Ye Ling, raised the corners of his mouth slightly and said with a smile.
"Master, it seems that our arrival has attracted the attention of some guys. Now that they are coming to our door, what should we do? Have they all been killed?"
All I can say is that she truly deserves to be the mother queen of the Zerg clan. She shouts and kills when she opens and shuts up, showing no mercy at all.
"No rush, let's check the situation first."
After Ye Ling's voice fell, several unfamiliar auras that appeared earlier appeared not far in front of them.
Swish, swish, swish!
Several figures blocked Ye Ling's path.
There were four people in total, each of them looked strong and tall, but their appearance was quite ferocious.
One of the guys only had one eye, and another guy had four eyes.
But these guys have one thing in common, that is, they have horns on their heads that belong to the ghost tribe.
The only person who has such strange characteristics but comes from the same clan can only be a guy from the ghost clan.
The leader of the one-eyed ghost clan immediately raised his right hand to stop Ye Ling and the others and shouted to stop.
"Who?! What are you doing here!"
